items.title: Annie Ross interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: And my mother thought I was going to be, you know, a Shirley Temple. Well they already had a Shirley Temple.

ctx.x: Yeah. So I won. I had a kilt and a glengarry and all those Scottish things, and I went out to Hollywood. And my mother thought I was going to be, you know, a Shirley Temple. Well they already had a Shirley Temple. So I just settled down and went to school.
Did you go out there with a family member?
